_comment: PLANNED dependency list for the AI Writing Assistant web app. This documents the technology choices from docs/03-technology-stack.md. Versions are intentionally left as placeholders ('*') until the project is initialised in Phase 1, at which point exact, pinned versions are installed. This file is a plan, not yet an installable manifest.
name: ai-writing-assistant
description: An AI-powered story bible: reads a writer's prose and compiles a cross-referenced, hyperlinked reference library. The AI compiles and cross-references; it never writes or edits the story.

scripts._comment_scripts: Planned commands. 'dev' runs the site locally; 'worker' runs the background extraction worker; 'db:*' manage the database via Prisma.

dependencies._comment_auth: Sign in with Google + secure sessions (doc 05).
dependencies._comment_db: Database access via the Prisma ORM (doc 04).
dependencies._comment_jobs: Background job queue for slow AI extraction (doc 02, 07).
dependencies._comment_ai: AI provider SDKs. Anthropic is the default provider (doc 07).
dependencies._comment_validation: Runtime validation of all incoming/AI data (doc 05, 07).

devDependencies._comment_db_dev: Prisma CLI for migrations and schema management.
devDependencies._comment_quality: Linting and formatting for consistent, readable code.
